content_sections.heading: VNMKV Field Assistant and Computer Operator Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About VNMKV
content_sections.text: Vasant Rao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth is based at Parbhani, and its Agricultural Research Station is at Badnapur in Jalna district. The Badnapur station is one of the centres identified to implement this project, and it is conducting the recruitment.

content_sections.heading: About the National Mission on High Yielding Seeds Pigeonpea
content_sections.text: The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) has sanctioned this project for 2026-27. It aims to: enhance hybrid performance through genetic profiling and heterotic pools map genomic loci restoring pollen fertility in A2 CMS improve parental lines for tolerance to biotic and abiotic stresses identify high yielding hybrids in pigeonpea in Maharashtra state

content_sections.text: Scrutiny and verification of original documents Interview

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The posts are to be filled purely on a temporary basis up to 31 March 2027, or earlier depending on the availability of the budget in the project. The appointment will be on contract basis. The incumbent shall not have any claim for regular appointment under VNMKV, Parbhani. The place of work is the Agricultural Research Station, Badnapur, Dist. Jalna.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VNMKV Field Assistant and Computer Operator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the Agricultural Research Station, Badnapur on the walk-in date. Be present at 10.00 am for scrutiny and verification of your original documents. Appear for the interview at 11.00 am in the chamber of the Officer Incharge. Documents to carry: The required original documents One set of attested Xerox copies

faq.question: Q1. Which degree is needed for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture.

faq.question: Q2. Do Computer Operator candidates need a computer certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. Along with a degree in any subject, they need MS-CIT or DOEACC, and they must have typing in Marathi and English.

faq.question: Q3. Is experience compulsory for these posts?
faq.answer: No. Experience is listed as desirable for both posts, and experienced candidates should be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. Can a candidate older than 45 attend?
faq.answer: Only a candidate covered by the relaxation can. It applies as per rule to the SC, ST, NT and OBC categories.

faq.question: Q5. Why is there a one-hour gap before the interview?
faq.answer: The hour from 10.00 am is set aside for checking original documents, and the interview starts at 11.00 am.

faq.question: Q6. Will the job become permanent?
faq.answer: The notice rules out any claim for regular appointment under VNMKV, Parbhani, and the posts run only up to 31 March 2027 at most.

faq.question: Q7. Will travel costs for the interview be paid?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided for appearing at the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Whose chamber is the interview held in?
faq.answer: The interview is held in the chamber of the Officer Incharge at the Agricultural Research Station, Badnapur.
